_meta.description: VeganSaathi Source Registry — every acquisition source must have a record here before any data may enter the pipeline. No source may enter production acquisition until review_status is 'approved'.

sources.name: Overture Maps Foundation — Places
sources.attribution_requirement: Overture Maps Foundation — per-source attribution for upstream providers (OSM: ODbL, Meta/Microsoft/etc: check per record). Keep source_dataset field.
sources.permitted_use: Free use, modification, redistribution. Must include attribution. Per-record source provenance must be retained.
sources.storage_restrictions: No restrictions on copying or caching for open use. Upstream source attribution must be preserved.
sources.photo_rights: No photographs supplied. Place record metadata only.
sources.geographic_coverage: Global. Maharashtra bounding box extraction: lat 15.6–22.0, lon 72.6–80.9
sources.retrieval_method: DuckDB query against s3://overturemaps-us-west-2/release/2026-10-21.0/theme=places/type=place/*. Pinned release. Live S3 streaming blocked on Windows DLL; local fixture testing active.
sources.cost_status: FREE (CDLA Permissive 2.0) — zero-cost public S3 read. NOT approved for unconstrained bulk ingestion.
sources.free_quota: No quota — public S3 read, pays egress on AWS us-west-2 (effectively free for Maharashtra extract ~50–200 MB)
sources.retention_policy: Raw extract kept locally in data/raw/, NOT committed to Git. Processed candidates kept in data/processed/.
sources.notes: Overture confidence score measures existence probability, NOT vegan status. GERS ID must be preserved for cross-release matching. Contains records from multiple upstream sources; per-record source_dataset field identifies provenance. Known issues: duplicates, junk records, incomplete addresses. Do not use confidence as vegan verification. SCHEMA v2.0.0 NOTE: Officially launched 2026-09-23.0; latest published release as of November 2026 is 2026-10-21.0. The adapter queries basic_category and taxonomy fields. Legacy categories struct is completely removed. RUNTIME NOTE: DuckDB httpfs direct S3 streaming encounters a known DLL initialization failure on Windows x64; pre-downloaded GeoParquet or Linux/macOS environment required for live execution. Live acquisition is disabled locally (live_acquisition_verified: false). Zero synthetic or unverified places in production.
sources.schema_version: v2.0.0 (breaking change from v1: categories struct removed, replaced by basic_category and taxonomy map)
schema_breaking_changes: categories.primary removed — use basic_category (coarse label e.g. restaurant, cafe)
taxonomy.primary added (granular classification label matching last element of hierarchy)
taxonomy.hierarchy added (ordered list of string hierarchy path e.g. ["food_and_drink", ...])

sources.name: Foursquare Open Source Places
sources.attribution_requirement: Must retain NOTICE file. Apache 2.0 attribution. FSQ Place ID should be preserved for provenance.
sources.permitted_use: Free use, modification, distribution. Must retain licence and NOTICE. No field-level restrictions documented beyond licence.
sources.storage_restrictions: Apache 2.0 — may store and redistribute with attribution.
sources.photo_rights: No photographs in the open dataset. Photos are a separate commercial API.
sources.geographic_coverage: Global. 100M+ POIs. Requires portal registration and Iceberg/token access.
sources.dataset_version: Pinned portal release required before acquisition; no default/latest release is permitted
sources.retrieval_method: Foursquare Places Portal Iceberg REST catalogue only. Requires portal-provided endpoint, warehouse, namespace/table names, token, and pinned release. No API endpoint, legacy S3 path, Snowflake, or unverified mirror fallback.
sources.cost_status: BLOCKED: Provider describes OS Places data as free, but project has not verified portal quotas, transfer/access costs, or local zero-cost terms. Explicit zero-cost owner confirmation is required before query.
sources.free_quota: Not verified for this project. Do not infer no quota or cost from the Apache 2.0 data licence.
sources.retention_policy: Local processing only. Data/raw/ not committed to Git.
sources.notes: Official documentation describes a free OS Places dataset under Apache 2.0, accessed through the Places Portal and an Iceberg REST catalogue token. This does not establish the project account quota, transfer cost, exact endpoint/table/version, or local acquisition cost. No live access was attempted. Require the portal-provided settings, exact release, explicit Apache-2.0 and zero-cost confirmations. Preserve Foursquare NOTICE and place ID provenance. Do not call commercial Places API endpoints or fall back to unverified mirrors.
sources.owner_action_required: Before any live access, verify the portal account terms, limits, access method, exact release and local transfer costs are ₹0; configure all settings as local environment values without committing secrets.

sources.name: OpenStreetMap — Geofabrik India Extract
sources.attribution_requirement: Must display '© OpenStreetMap contributors' on any map or derived product. ODbL share-alike may apply to derivative databases — legal review required before distribution.
sources.permitted_use: Free download, processing, local analysis. Attribution required. If distributing a derivative database that incorporates OSM data, ODbL share-alike obligation applies. Consult legal advice before creating a publicly searchable database that re-distributes OSM data.
sources.storage_restrictions: May store locally for processing. Distributing a derivative database that IS substantially OSM-derived requires ODbL compliance and attribution. VeganSaathi will use OSM data as a discovery input only — curated records in Firestore are individually sourced and cited, not a derivative database reproduction of OSM.
sources.photo_rights: No photos in PBF extract. Some OSM nodes have image= or wikimedia_commons= tags — verify individual rights.
sources.geographic_coverage: India national. Western India sub-region for Maharashtra focus.
sources.retrieval_method: Direct download via HTTPS. Processing with osmium-tool or pyosmium. NOT using public Overpass API for bulk queries.
sources.free_quota: Unlimited download. Attribution required. Rate limit: be respectful to Geofabrik servers.
sources.retention_policy: PBF file kept locally in data/raw/osm/. Not committed to Git (.gitignore excludes *.pbf). Filtered output kept in data/processed/osm/.
sources.notes: Vegan tags (diet:vegan=yes, diet:vegan=only, cuisine=vegan) are discovery signals, not verification. Many Indian vegan establishments may not have OSM vegan tags. ODbL legal review recommended before distributing any derivative database. Use as a research input, not as the sole source of truth.

sources.name: SHARAN India — Certified Restaurants List
sources.provider: SHARAN India (Sanctuary for Health and Reconnection to Animals and Nature)
sources.attribution_requirement: Must credit SHARAN India as the source of any lead. Cannot republish their directory.
sources.permitted_use: RESEARCH LEAD ONLY. The public page lists restaurants. Each listing should be treated as a research lead requiring independent verification. Do not bulk-scrape or replicate their directory. Use as pointers for manual follow-up research.
sources.storage_restrictions: Do not reproduce their directory content. Each business found via SHARAN must be independently verified and sourced from the business's own public information before entering VeganSaathi.
sources.photo_rights: Do not copy any photographs from SHARAN India website.
sources.retrieval_method: Manual page review only. No automated scraping.
sources.notes: Use only as a research lead source. Each business must be independently researched and verified. Category shown by SHARAN must be noted but not automatically transferred. Some listings may be vegetarian, not fully vegan.
sources.adapter_note: No automated adapter. Manual research workflow only.

sources.name: HappyCow
sources.permitted_use: BLOCKED. HappyCow terms prohibit automated retrieval, indexing, or creating competing databases from their content.
sources.photo_rights: BLOCKED. Do not copy any HappyCow photos.
sources.notes: Do not scrape. Do not use HappyCow content in VeganSaathi. May be used as a manual research reference to identify business names, then independently verify via official business websites.
sources.adapter_note: BLOCKED — no adapter to be implemented.

sources.name: Openverse
sources.licence_name: Per-image (CC BY, CC0, CC BY-SA, etc.)
sources.attribution_requirement: Per-image: required attribution to creator, source platform, licence. Must display on every use.
sources.permitted_use: Search and use openly licensed images. Licence varies per image — must check individually. Some are CC0 (public domain), some require attribution, some are NC or ND.
sources.storage_restrictions: May store locally and serve if licence permits. Must retain attribution metadata. Do not store images that are NC if used commercially.
sources.photo_rights: Licence metadata from Openverse is not guaranteed accurate — verify at original source URL.
sources.free_quota: API rate limited — 100 requests/day without token, higher with free token registration.
sources.notes: Use ONLY for generic educational or illustrative images, never as a photo of a specific restaurant unless the image is confirmed to be of that place. Verify every licence individually. Store attribution metadata with every stored image.

sources.name: Wikimedia Commons
sources.attribution_requirement: Per-file. Must attribute author and source. Many files require CC BY-SA share-alike.
sources.permitted_use: Free use with per-file licence compliance. Verify each file individually.
sources.photo_rights: Per-file — verify at the Commons file page.
sources.notes: Do not assume all Commons files have the same licence. Verify each file's licensing page. Attribution to author is required for most files. CC BY-SA requires share-alike on derivative works.

sources.name: Google Places API
sources.licence_name: Google Maps Platform Terms of Service
sources.permitted_use: RESTRICTED. Cannot store most Place content. Place IDs can be stored. Data must be displayed on Google Maps. Caching is restricted. Not suitable as a bulk-import or offline database source.
sources.cost_status: BLOCKED — BILLING REQUIRED AND TERMS PROHIBIT BULK USE
sources.notes: Do not use as a data source for VeganSaathi. Terms prohibit creating competing databases from Google Places content. Attribution rules prohibit using Place data on non-Google maps. Zero budget — billing not permitted.
